implementation: Work retains a cancellation-only lifetime guard on the real original interpreter. The Host verifies the ownership source, active Goal and coordination binding, claim and policy before and during waits, including remote requests with no active tool authorization.

History revisions stay part of fresh dispatch authorization. Retiring an already admitted interpreter uses the ownership facts separately so appending a Tool Result cannot free or revoke a valid Work's interpreter by itself.
The existing attempt cancellation stops the original Registry handle, records its real group closure and preserves prior receipts. The watcher never authorizes a second command.

verified.priorControlledBinary: The same bounded real Work test observes an interpreter still alive at the three-second deadline while the second model response is withheld.
verified.candidate: Policy change while the second response is withheld reaps the interpreter group before the server returns. The first dispatch receipt is preserved and the second command has no effect.
verified.retainedMacInitialTimeout: One concurrent run hit the eight-second process-exit guard after the fixture's persisted stop receipt with no unknown calls. The initial log is retained. The same tests passed five concurrent repetitions and a final scoped run. Cause not established.

backgroundBaseline.willProve: Two real process groups, stable startup receipts, selected group stop, other group remains active, duplicate stop observes prior ending, and the Work exit closes the remaining group.

deployment: Isolated Work candidate; no merge, installation or old installed Host drain.
